summary:
Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository; nothing was committed and no tests, Black, or repository code were run.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType (no renumbering) and added Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union.
- rich/control.py: registered the sequence ESC ] 0 ; title BEL in CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and added Control.title(title), returning an unstyled Control with a docstring.
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor. It returns True after writing the control when is_terminal, otherwise False. No try/except.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: added a dispatch branch that calls term.set_title(title) with the control's second item. _win32_console.py already had set_title, so it is unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: added an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_console.py (set_window_title writes the sequence and returns True; skipped on win32), test_control.py (Control.title segment and control entry), test_windows_renderer.py (mocked set_title called once with "Hello, world!"; Windows-only file).

Not verified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not applied, so the 88-column requirement is checked by reading only.
